why: Committed test fixture. ENTIRELY SYNTHETIC - invented campaign ids, invented amounts, an August 2026 date with invented ids. Contains no account data, which is why it can live in git while google-ads/outputs/ cannot. Generated by tools/make_fixture.py; edit that, not this.

campaigns-current.json.note: Synthetic. 7 enabled campaigns: brand, non-brand, PMax, TOF, a dormant shell, and TWO on one shared budget id so the VF-19 fan-out guard has something to catch.

campaign-cost-is-7d.json.note: Synthetic. PMax carries the 0.0999 '<10%' impression-share sentinel so the VF-11 suppression path runs, and a 0.55 lost-to-budget so the constrained-cluster path runs.

campaign-cost-is-prior7d.json.note: Synthetic prior week - genuinely the 7 days BEFORE the current window (the pair guard refuses an overlapping or identical week).

campaign-conversions-7d.json.filter: campaign.status='ENABLED' AND segments.date DURING LAST_7_DAYS AND segments.conversion_action_name IN (the 8)
campaign-conversions-7d.json.note: Synthetic. 8-action only. TOF has none on purpose, so the rule-1 no-efficiency-fact path runs.

campaign-conversions-prior7d.json.filter: campaign.status='ENABLED' AND segments.date BETWEEN '2026-07-25' AND '2026-07-31' AND segments.conversion_action_name IN (the 8)
campaign-conversions-prior7d.json.note: Synthetic prior week. TOF converts here and not this week, so the membership-differs-between-weeks path runs.

account-spend-mtd.json.note: Synthetic. Customer-level, NO status filter - that is what makes it the right pacing instrument and why it must never be differenced against an enabled-only sum.

change-events-14d.json.note: Synthetic. Includes a PMax budget change INSIDE its 28-day window - the row that catches the line-898 ordering bug - and a second operator so a single-author claim cannot pass.

search-terms-cost-30d.json.note: Synthetic. One row per decision branch plus three structural hazards: a duplicate identity, a criterion id reused across two ad groups, and a clicks-exceeding-impressions row. ad_group.name is present so the Editor-import lint has something to pass.

search-terms-conversions-30d.json.filter: segments.date DURING LAST_30_DAYS AND segments.conversion_action_name IN (the 8)

donotnegate-90d-8action.json.filter: segments.date BETWEEN '2026-05-10' AND '2026-08-07' AND segments.conversion_action_name IN (the 8)
donotnegate-90d-8action.json.note: Synthetic 90-day clearance. Holds ONE term, 'kept-by-90d', which the 30-day pull shows as a zero-conversion negate candidate. That single row is the whole test of the guard.

campaign-assets-current.json.note: Synthetic. One asset shared across 3 campaigns, and one attachment on a campaign absent from campaigns-current.json so the status-filter defect has something to join out.

customer-assets-current.json.note: Synthetic account-level assets, so the inheritance path resolves.

audit-ad-copy-rsa-inventory.json.filter: ad_group_ad.status = 'ENABLED' AND ad_group.status = 'ENABLED' AND campaign.status = 'ENABLED' AND campaign.advertising_channel_type = 'SEARCH' AND ad_group_ad.ad.type = 'RESPONSIVE_SEARCH_AD'
audit-ad-copy-rsa-inventory.json.note: Synthetic. 13 servable RSAs; ad 1 carries a never-serving live headline (the dead slot) and ad 13 a TRADEMARK policy topic.

audit-ad-copy-rsa-metrics-30d.json.filter: ad_group_ad.status = 'ENABLED' AND ad_group.status = 'ENABLED' AND campaign.status = 'ENABLED' AND campaign.advertising_channel_type = 'SEARCH' AND ad_group_ad.ad.type = 'RESPONSIVE_SEARCH_AD' AND segments.date DURING LAST_30_DAYS
audit-ad-copy-rsa-metrics-30d.json.note: Synthetic. Costs arranged so the serve-table rule selects 11 of 13 (top 10 plus one above the CAD 2,000 floor) - the diet's exercise.

audit-ad-copy-rsa-conversions-30d.json.filter: ad_group_ad.status = 'ENABLED' AND campaign.status = 'ENABLED' AND ad_group_ad.ad.type = 'RESPONSIVE_SEARCH_AD' AND segments.conversion_action_name IN (the 8) AND segments.date DURING LAST_30_DAYS
audit-ad-copy-rsa-conversions-30d.json.note: Synthetic 8-action conversions at the ad level (two-query rule).

audit-ad-copy-asset-serves-30d.json.filter: ad_group_ad_asset_view.field_type IN ('HEADLINE','DESCRIPTION') AND segments.date DURING LAST_30_DAYS
audit-ad-copy-asset-serves-30d.json.note: Synthetic HEADLINE serves for ads 1, 2 and 12 - one dead slot, one removed-but-served row, and ad 12 excluded by the serve-table rule so the diet's totals-still-cover-everything property is testable.

asset-field-type-30d.json.note: Synthetic serve data. Asset-credited and double-counting across field types by design.
